searchText: In that case, I have a question for miners: Do you plan on overriding geth's default min tip of 1 wei? If so, to what value? Tough question your assuming miners will bother to fill blocks with anything that isn't mev Should be plenty of free block space 😉 Yep, but if we collaborate we just force everything off market to mev providers and get paid through coinbase instead of gas So you'd have to assume that the tip is worth the risk of uncling and that the risk of losing that mev income is worth less than the tips Basically you have to assume that mining pools care about the future of eth, aren't profit-seeking, and that they aren't organized. Any thoughts on where we should share it for more reach ? idk, post in wechat? Also, I agree 1 gwei is too low: it probably barely compensates pre-MEV blocks’ uncling risk. Seems like some are adopting Uber/Tesla models where they offer pools more than cost to expand fast I’m not sure what you mean by that? The pools that won't update will be just leaving money on the table for other pools to take, right? As long as an enough share of pools update, the average block size won't go down, it will just fluctuate a bit and some pools will make more money. Yeah exactly, unless the price is so low it is not worth it for anyone to pick up the txn. I think 1 gwei is probably too low, and last time I checked 2 gwei would make it “worth it” for ~50% of blocks with MEV bundles, and 3 gwei was enough for ~80% You lose the profit from that mev if your uncled so it assumes that mev is worth xxx. But because mev companies are offering 2-3x more than mev is currently worth to push expansion/adoption then that risk also goes up significantly. Especially if the tip goes to the miners but the mev income goes to the pools wallet.
